rootCause: The web_fetch failureDetector ran a substring scan (/blocked|403|forbidden|connection refused/i) over the entire ~50KB serialized body; the bare substring '403' matched a price/quote field, flipping 8 status-200 successes to failures at pi-event-bridge.ts; the per-tool retry breaker then tripped on those false failures and told the model 'DO NOT retry', cascading into a fragile disk-parse + SVG->sips fallback.
hiddenMechanism: No log/event/trajectory/RPC field records WHY a status-200 response was classified as failed — transportOk / httpStatus / matchedRule / classifiedFailureBy do not exist anywhere in the surface. The raw log shows finishReason:"stop" and errorKind:"dependency", never the substring-match that caused the flip.
